messages:
Iris (Finance): Quick syncProduct wants to run a 3-arm mid-market pricing experiment next month. We need a decision matrix for invoice treatment when accounts switch cohorts mid-billing-cycle, plus grandfathering length and how we reflect experiment IDs for reconciliation. Looping in @Devin @Vik @CFO.

Maya (Product): Plan: control = current list, variant A = +12% list with same thresholds, variant B = +25% with higher thresholds and free trial extension. Target cohort: 4% of mid-market for 30 days. Want experiment_id on export rows. No invoice PDF changes.

Devin (Billing Ops): Key ops constraint: our current pipeline produces one consolidated invoice per account per month. We can: 1) prorate charges by days in cohort, 2) bill consolidated usage and run a recon pass, or 3) attach per-cohort line-items (harder). Preference: provisional prorate + month-end recon with adjustment rules.

Vik (Engineering): Export change easy: add experiment_id and assignment_date to billing_export. Caveat: ticket #4122 shows historical assignment_date nulls for legacy accounts; could bias cohort attribution. I can backfill from audit logs but need 24h.

Iris (Finance): Grandfathering proposal: existing customers keep old per-token rates for 60 days after assignment unless contract renewal sooner. CFO wants optional automatic extension to 120d for strategic accounts.

CFO (Exec): Confirming: strategic accounts (>$50k ARR) can get extended grandfathering automatically. Let's document criteria. Also want a quick revenue impact estimate for the canary (topline delta + COGS).

Devin (Billing Ops): On adjustments: propose thresholds: material delta > $75 -> corrected invoice where gateway supports it; $10-$75 -> credit memo; < $10 -> auto-credit. Need to confirm whether Chargebee supports corrected invoice numbers via API.

payments-bot: Chargebee note: invoice.custom_fields supported, corrected_invoice_number not supported. Workaround: issue credit_note and new invoice; or include reference in invoice_notes.

Maya (Product): Acceptance CRs: 1) net revenue delta within +/-2.5% in canary cohort, 2) <1% bump in billing tickets, 3) experiment_id present on exports for 100% of cohort events.

Vik (Engineering): I'll push export schema change to staging and run backfill job for audit logs today. Will post CSV sample in #eng-billing.

Iris (Finance): On mid-cycle calculation, here's the tentative prorate calc we discussed: 
```
pro_rated_charge = daily_rate * days_in_assignment
where daily_rate = monthly_list_price / days_in_month
```
Recon pass will compare actual usage bucket pricing to provisional and issue adjustments per thresholds.

Devin (Billing Ops): We also need to tag invoices with experiment_id in the export rows for reconciliations. For customer-facing PDFs, we'll avoid any experiment labels.

CFO (Exec): Please include a short escalation path in the runbook: who signs off on adjustments > $5k, and a SLAT for issuing refunds/credits.

Iris (Finance): Good point. I'll draft the runbook sections: thresholds, refund SLA (72h for credits < $500, 7 days for > $500), and CFO sign-off for > $5k.

Devin (Billing Ops): Quick poll: corrected invoice preferred when gateway supports it. React :one: corrected invoice, :two: credit note workaround.

Maya (Product): :one: (corrected invoice)

CFO (Exec): :two: (credit note ok)

Vik (Engineering): :one: (corrected invoice)

Iris (Finance): Split. We'll confirm vendor behavior and default to credit note if needed. Devin, please confirm by EOD and post runbook draft in /docs.

Devin (Billing Ops): Will do. Action items: 1) confirm Chargebee/Stripe corrected invoice capability, 2) implement experiment_id + assignment_date in export, 3) runbackfill for assignment_date, 4) draft runbook and customer wording.

payments-bot: Scheduled job "schema-change-billing_export" for 2025-03-05T02:00:00Z (job id: schema-bill-2025-03-05).

Iris (Finance): Thanks all. If staging recon shows >3% revenue delta we pause. Post runbook when ready and include sample CSV for signoff.
